pois.label: 龙门吊（0.38 g 起重学）
pois.detail: 跨堆场的黄色龙门吊,小车沿 20 m 主梁往复,转锁吊具抓标准箱。火星起重的甜头:同一只 10 t 集装箱在这里只压 37 kN(地球 98 kN),同样的钢结构额定值放大 2.6 倍。但小车开得很慢——那是刻意的。
pois.detail_en: The yellow gantry spans the stack, its trolley shuttling along a 20 m beam with a twist-lock spreader. The Martian lifting bargain: a 10 t container presses down only 37 kN here against 98 kN on Earth, so the same steel is rated 2.6x higher. Yet the trolley crawls - deliberately.
pois.sim: 起重账:重量 mg 随 0.38 缩,但摆动、启停、刹车全由质量 m 决定——m 一克没少。吊 10 t 箱的水平加减速载荷与地球完全相同,小车限速就是把「重量便宜了」和「惯性没便宜」两笔账分开记。
pois.sim_en: Lifting ledger: weight mg scales by 0.38, but swing, starting, and braking are governed by mass m - and not one gram of it left. Horizontal accel loads on a 10 t box match Earth exactly; the trolley speed limit is the bookkeeping that separates cheap weight from full-price inertia.
pois.physics: 低重力搬运的普适定律:凡是「抬」的都打 0.38 折,凡是「加速」的原价——起重机变轻了,刹车距离和吊物摆角一点没变。和村里自行车的刹车账是同一条物理。
pois.physics_en: The universal law of low-g handling: everything that lifts gets the 0.38 discount, everything that accelerates pays full price. The crane got lighter; braking distances and load swing did not. Same physics as the village bikes' braking ledger.

pois.label: 集装箱堆场（每窗口的吞吐）
pois.detail: 两列错落的火星标准箱(4.4×2.4×2.2 m,按长十乙货舱包络定尺)。每只箱有编号有去向:进港的是地球来的精密件与备件,出港的是样品、返修件和 ISRU 副产品。堆高不超过两层——不是吊不动,是尘暴风载算的。
pois.detail_en: Two staggered rows of Mars-standard boxes (4.4 x 2.4 x 2.2 m, sized to the CZ-10B cargo envelope). Every box has a number and a destination: inbound carries Earth precision parts and spares, outbound samples, returns, and ISRU byproducts. Stacks stop at two high - not a crane limit, a dust-storm wind-load calculation.

specs.流向: 进口备件 / 出口样品与返修件

specs_en.Flow: spares in, samples and returns out

sim: 吞吐账:ISRU 200 kWe 产能对应每会合窗口 3.3 次发射(长十乙战役账),LMO 单发 18~24 t——一个窗口的天地吞吐折合 60~80 t,约 15~20 只满载箱。这个堆场按两个窗口的峰值缓冲定容。
粮食上货单（总控裁定：方案 C 对半）：全城 115 人本地热量自给率仅 8.3%（种植面 519 m²），进口主粮 71.6 t/会合窗口——等于旧 60~80 t 包线的全部。裁定：吞吐包线重述为 ~100 t/窗口（食物约占一半），同时新建主粮种植舱 res-grain-01 把自给率拉向 50%；堆肥自举时间表约 16 个火星年达到全热量自给（res-recycle-01 堆肥卡）。
sim_en: Throughput ledger: 200 kWe of ISRU supports 3.3 launches per synodic window (the CZ-10B campaign ledger), 18-24 t to LMO each - 60-80 t of orbit-bound cargo per window, some 15-20 full boxes. The yard is sized to buffer two windows' peaks.

Food on the manifest (integrator ruling: option C, half and half): at 8.3% local caloric self-sufficiency (519 m2 of beds), the city imports 71.6 t of staples per synodic window - the whole of the old 60-80 t envelope. Ruling: the envelope is restated to ~100 t per window, roughly half of it food, while a staple-crop module res-grain-01 grows self-sufficiency toward 50%; the compost bootstrap reaches full caloric independence in about 16 Mars years (res-recycle-01 compost card).
pois.physics: 标准化是物流的第一物理:箱型统一后,吊具、拖车、发射台托架、货舱锁定点全部收敛成一套接口——火星上每一种「转接件」都是从地球运来的质量。
pois.physics_en: Standardization is the first physics of logistics: one box format collapses spreaders, trailers, pad cradles, and bay latch points into a single interface - and on Mars, every adapter is mass shipped from Earth.

pois.label: 拱仓（26 个月的备件深度）
pois.label_en: Arch warehouse (26 months of spares depth)
pois.detail: 半圆拱备件仓,卷帘门朝东。里面按失效率排货架:滤芯、密封圈、泵、电路板——都是「等地球补给等不起」的东西。拱形依旧是那笔结构账:曲面受压,方盒受弯。
pois.detail_en: The half-arch spares warehouse, roll-door facing east. Shelved by failure rate: filters, seals, pumps, circuit boards - everything that cannot wait for the next resupply. The arch is the same structural ledger as ever: curves take compression, boxes take bending.
sim: 库存账:补给窗口 26 个月一班,任何备件的安全库存 = 失效率 × 26 个月在途 + 峰值余量。地球上「下周到货」的零件,在这里全部换算成货架深度——仓库的体积就是会合周期的几何表达。

核材料衡算（总控裁定，依 pwr-fission-01 §7 ⑮）：全城核材料的库存、封存与转移记录归本仓的台账体系——衡算是库存学不是堆工。现状一行：800 kg 铀（19.75% HALEU，含 158 kg U-235）分装 8 个堆芯于 pwr-fission-01 舱位，十年燃耗 1.6%；乏模块原位回填封存（十年后衰变热约 210 W，覆土导热即可），无转移则无记录项。物理保管在堆址，账在这里。
sim_en: Inventory ledger: resupply runs every 26 months, so safe stock of any part equals failure rate times a 26-month pipeline plus peak margin. Parts that arrive 'next week' on Earth convert here into shelf depth - this building's volume is the synodic period expressed as geometry.

Nuclear material accountancy (integrator ruling, per pwr-fission-01 section 7, item 15): the inventory, sealing, and transfer records for all nuclear material in the city belong to this warehouse's ledger system - accountancy is warehousing, not reactor engineering. The standing entry: 800 kg of uranium (19.75% HALEU, 158 kg of U-235) across 8 cores in their pwr-fission-01 bays, 1.6% burned in ten years; spent modules are entombed in place under their own berm (about 210 W of decay heat after a decade, carried by regolith conduction), and no transfer means no ledger movement. Physical custody stays at the reactor; the books live here.
pois.physics: 行星际物流没有加急件:轨道力学规定发货日。所以火星的仓储策略更像远洋帆船时代——库存深度不是管理选择,是天体力学边条件。
pois.physics_en: Interplanetary logistics has no express shipping: orbital mechanics sets the sailing dates. Martian warehousing thus reads like the age of sail - stock depth is not a management choice but a celestial-mechanics boundary condition.

pois.label: 装卸坪（三泊位 + 平板拖车）
pois.label_en: Loading apron (three bays and a flatbed)
pois.detail: 标线三泊位朝着东干道,一台平板拖车正载着蓝箱等牵引。这里是「最后一公里」的接口:重货走拖车沿路网,轻货直接吊上巡逻车货斗。旁边的充电桩管拖车电驱——全城车辆同一套 400 V 直流标准。
pois.detail_en: Three marked bays face the east trunk road, a flatbed trailer waiting with a blue box aboard. This is the last-kilometre interface: heavy cargo rides trailers down the road network, light loads go straight into rover beds. The charge post feeds the trailer's electric drive - one 400 V DC standard city-wide.

specs.拖车: 平板电驱,载 1 标准箱

pois.sim: 周转账:一只箱从发射场到用户 = 公路 40 分钟 + 吊装两次(每次 ~6 分钟)。瓶颈不在吊也不在路,在「箱到人」的开箱清点——所以泊位设三个:一个在卸,一个在检,一个在等。
pois.sim_en: Turnaround ledger: one box from pad to user takes a 40-minute road leg plus two crane cycles of ~6 minutes. The bottleneck is neither crane nor road but box-to-hands inventory check - hence three bays: one unloading, one inspecting, one queued.
pois.physics: 物流坪的排队论:到达是批量的(一船一批),消费是连续的——缓冲区的意义就是把「脉冲到货」整流成「稳定发料」。堆场和拱仓是同一只电容的两极。
pois.physics_en: Queueing theory of the apron: arrivals come in pulses (one ship, one batch) while consumption is continuous - the yard exists to rectify pulsed delivery into steady issue. Stack and warehouse are two plates of the same capacitor.
